1.w: Children, obey your⁺ parents in the Lord, for this is right.

2.w: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise,

3.w: “that it may be well with you and you will be long-lived upon the earth.”

4.w: And fathers, do not provoke to anger your⁺ children, but nourish them in the discipline and admonition of the Lord.

5.w: Slaves, obey the masters according to the flesh with fear and trembling, in sincerity of your⁺ heart, as to Christ,

6.w: not with eye-service as men-pleasers, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from the soul,

7.w: serving with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,

8.w: knowing that each one, whatever good he might have done, this he will receive from the Lord, whether slave or free.

9.w: And masters, do the same things toward them, giving up threatening, knowing that also their Master and yours⁺ is in the heavens, and there is no partiality with Him.

10.w: Henceforth, be empowered in the Lord and in the might of His strength.

11.w: Put on the full armor of God, for you⁺ to be able to stand against the schemes of the devil,

12.w: because to us the wrestling is not against blood and flesh, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the world powers of this darkness, against the spiritual [forces] of evil in the heavenly realms.

13.w: Because of this, take up the full armor of God, so that you⁺ may be able to withstand in the day of evil, and having done all things, to stand.

14.w: Stand therefore, having girded your⁺ loins in truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

15.w: and having shod the feet in the readiness of the gospel of peace;

16.w: in all, having taken up the shield of faith, in which you⁺ will be able to quench all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

17.w: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,

18.w: through all prayer and supplication, praying in the Spirit in every season and unto this very thing, staying awake with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,

19.w: and for me, that word may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make known in boldness the mystery of the gospel,

20.w: for which I am an ambassador in a chain, that in it I may be bold, as it is necessary for me to speak.

21.w: And so that you⁺ also may know the things concerning me—what I am doing—Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you⁺ all things,

22.w: whom I sent to you⁺ for this, that you⁺ might know the things concerning us, and he may encourage your⁺ hearts.

23.w: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

24.w: Grace [be] with all those loving our Lord Jesus Christ in incorruptibility.
